item.stem:
The diagram shows a $2$ by $1$ by $1$ solid of unit cubes on an isometric grid. Komal wants to read its length, depth, and height from the grid.

Which claim is correct?

options.A: Count $2$ units along length, $1$ along depth, and $1$ along height using the three isometric grid directions.
options.B: Count the solid on a square grid only; the three isometric directions are not needed.
options.C: The three isometric grid directions are produced by the $2$ by $1$ by $1$ solid.
options.D: The same three isometric directions also serve for every flat square-grid drawing of a rectangle.
